items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: And who we had on the banjo? Henry Martin.

ctx.x: Did any of the fellas that have been with you in the Maple Leaf band go into your band?
No ma'am. Just a, let me see who came with me. Camilla Todd that was the pianist. And who else? I think Sam Dutrae, yeah. Sam Dutrae came. And who we had on the banjo? Henry Martin. The drummer?
He switched to banjo then? That's right, switched to banjo. That's right.

items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Is that so? Well, he was a good clarinet player too.

ctx.x: Is that so? Well, he was a good clarinet player too.
I heard him on record, you know, with this fellow, they called him Whining Boy, Jelly Roll Martin?
